stories.headline: 4.3 Million AI Repositories on GitHub Mark 178 Percent Year-Over-Year Growth
stories.excerpt: GitHub's annual report reveals AI-related repositories grew 178 percent year-over-year, now exceeding 4.3 million LLM-focused projects. The surge reflects both enterprise adoption and individual developer experimentation with open-source models, agents, and fine-tuning frameworks.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: Artemis II Crew Captures First Human-Taken Photographs of Lunar Far Side in Half a Century
stories.excerpt: The four-person Artemis II crew transmitted the first photographs taken by human eyes of the lunar far side since the Apollo era, as their Orion spacecraft completed its closest approach to the Moon at roughly 130 kilometers altitude. Mission controllers report all spacecraft systems performing nominally through the gravity assist maneuver.

stories.headline: US Economic Activity Expands at Solid Pace Despite Elevated Uncertainty, Fed Says
stories.excerpt: Federal Reserve officials characterized economic activity as expanding at a solid pace in their latest assessment, despite elevated uncertainty owing in part to the conflict in the Middle East. The committee noted softer hiring alongside sticky services inflation as reasons for maintaining the current rate stance.
stories.licenceBasis: Federal Reserve public domain — official minutes and statements

stories.headline: Pharmaceutical Giant Novo Nordisk Hit by Cyberattack Targeting Research Data
stories.excerpt: Danish pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk, maker of the blockbuster weight-loss drug Ozempic, disclosed a cyberattack that targeted research and development databases. The company said patient-facing services were not affected, but confirmed that proprietary drug development data may have been accessed by the attackers.

stories.headline: UN Report Declares Renewables at 'Irreversible Tipping Point' as Solar Leads Growth
stories.excerpt: A major United Nations energy report declared that renewable energy has reached an irreversible tipping point globally, with solar photovoltaic installations leading new capacity additions in every major economy. The report calls for maintaining momentum to meet the target of tripling renewable capacity by 2030.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from Earth.Org and UN energy reports

stories.headline: CRISPR Trial for Familial Hypercholesterolemia Achieves 60% LDL Reduction in Early Data
stories.excerpt: An early-phase clinical trial using CRISPR to edit the PCSK9 gene in patients with familial hypercholesterolemia achieved a 60% reduction in LDL cholesterol levels with a single infusion. The results, if confirmed in larger trials, could offer a permanent alternative to lifelong statin therapy for the estimated 30 million people worldwide with the condition.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches WebMCP Challenge: $30K Prize Pool for Agent-Native Web Apps
stories.excerpt: OpenAI announced the WebMCP Challenge, a 10-day hackathon offering $30,000 in prizes for developers building WebMCP-powered web applications that explore human-agent collaboration on the open web. The challenge accepts submissions until September 3 and is judged on WebMCP leverage, execution, potential impact, and creativity.
stories.licenceBasis: TechCrunch RSS excerpt with link-out, per feed terms of use

stories.headline: G20 Ministers Agree on Non-Binding AI Governance Principles for Cross-Border Deployment
stories.excerpt: G20 technology ministers agreed on a set of non-binding principles for the cross-border deployment of AI systems, covering transparency requirements, liability frameworks, and interoperability standards. The principles aim to prevent a fragmented regulatory landscape while preserving national sovereignty over AI safety rules.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from Reuters and G20 communiqué

stories.headline: ESA Euclid Telescope Data Reveals New Constraints on Dark Energy Equation of State
stories.excerpt: The European Space Agency released the first major science results from the Euclid space telescope, providing the tightest constraints yet on the dark energy equation of state. The data, covering observations of over 50 million galaxies, suggests dark energy's density may be evolving over time rather than remaining constant.

stories.headline: AI-Generated Deepfake Identities Used to Bypass KYC Checks at Major Financial Institutions
stories.excerpt: Cybercriminals are using sophisticated AI-generated deepfake identities to bypass know-your-customer verification checks at major financial institutions. The synthetic identity documents and video verification footage are realistic enough to defeat automated screening systems, prompting calls for next-generation biometric authentication standards.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from NVD and financial security reports

stories.headline: Webb Telescope Reveals Unexpectedly Massive Galaxies From Universe's First 500 Million Years
stories.excerpt: New James Webb Space Telescope observations revealed galaxies far more massive than expected from the universe's first 500 million years, challenging current models of early galaxy formation. The findings suggest star formation in the early universe was significantly more efficient than previously understood.

stories.headline: Solar Now Produces 58% of All New Electricity Generation Capacity Added Globally
stories.excerpt: Solar photovoltaic installations now account for 58% of all new electricity generation capacity added worldwide, outpacing wind, gas, and all other sources combined. The dominance is driven by rapidly falling panel costs, streamlined permitting in key markets, and massive manufacturing scale-up in China and Southeast Asia.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from RMI and IEA capacity data

stories.headline: Oil Futures Climb on Middle East Supply Concerns, Adding to Inflation Pressure
stories.excerpt: Crude oil futures climbed above $90 per barrel as ongoing conflict in the Middle East raised concerns about supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz. The elevated energy prices are adding to inflationary pressure globally and complicating the Federal Reserve's monetary policy calculations.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from CNBC and commodity market data

stories.headline: Northern Sea Route Sees Record Commercial Traffic as Arctic Ice Retreats
stories.excerpt: Commercial shipping traffic along Russia's Northern Sea Route reached record levels as Arctic ice retreat opened longer navigation windows. Environmental groups warn that increased vessel traffic poses collision risks to marine wildlife and raises the probability of fuel spills in fragile polar ecosystems.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from Reuters and Arctic monitoring data

stories.headline: Agent SDK Ecosystem Matures: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google All Ship Production Agent Toolkits
stories.excerpt: All three major AI providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google — now offer production-grade agent SDKs, standardizing patterns for tool use orchestration, multi-step reasoning, and structured output. The convergence signals that agentic AI has moved from experimental feature to core infrastructure across the industry.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from InfoWorld and provider documentation
